miners.name: TelegraphIntent
miners.description: One miner serving 33 Telegraph intents. FRAUD_RISK_GENERAL fuses IP reputation, Tor/VPN exposure, domain and phishing-feed reputation, card-BIN metadata and behavioural pattern rules into a graded risk level and abstains honestly when evidence is insufficient. FACT_CHECK_GENERAL checks a specific factual claim against multiple independent sources and returns a verdict with cited sources, abstaining when evidence is insufficient. CONTRACT_OBLIGATION_AUDIT_GENERAL extracts a contract's obligations, judges compliance and cites only clause wording verified to occur verbatim in the supplied contract (accepts the text or a link to an HTML or PDF). IP_GEOLOCATION_GENERAL locates an IP address by consensus of several keyless geolocation providers. EMAIL_SECURITY_GENERAL reports whether a DNS lookup of a given record type for a mail domain succeeds (DNS status NOERROR). URL_SAFE_GENERAL checks a URL against OpenPhish's live phishing feed and Cloudflare's malware and phishing DNS filter, counting the sources that flag it. MALWARE_DETECTION_HASH reports whether a file hash (MD5, SHA-1 or SHA-256), domain or IP address is flagged as malicious by CIRCL hashlookup, Team Cymru's malware hash registry, AlienVault OTX, OpenPhish and Cloudflare's security DNS. SANCTIONS_SCREENING_MATCH_GENERAL screens a name against OFAC's SDN and consolidated sanctions lists with fuzzy matching. CRYPTO_PRICE_USD returns a crypto asset's current dollar price as the consensus of several public exchanges. REGULATORY_FILING_MONITOR_GENERAL counts and lists SEC EDGAR filings in a period. CORPORATE_REGISTRY_LOOKUP_GENERAL looks a company up in GLEIF's LEI registry. SSL_VERIFICATION_CERT checks a host's TLS certificate with a real handshake. CVE_LOOKUP_CVSS returns a CVE's CVSS score and details from NVD. VULNERABILITY_TRIAGE_GENERAL returns a CVE's NVD CVSS base score. WEATHER_CHECK_TEMPERATURE returns a place's current air temperature in Celsius. WEATHER_FORECAST_GENERAL returns a place's forecast high, low, rain chance and condition. GAS_PRICE_GENERAL returns an EVM chain's gas price in gwei and the cost of a transfer. URL_SCAN_VERDICT says whether a URL is safe to visit. THREAT_INTELLIGENCE_INDICATOR reports whether an IP, domain or hash is flagged in public threat feeds. CURRENCY_EXCHANGE_CONVERT converts an amount between two currencies. FX_NOW_CAD returns the current USD/CAD exchange rate. FX_NOW_EUR returns the current USD/EUR exchange rate. FX_NOW_SEK returns the current USD/SEK exchange rate. DNS_RECORD_LOOKUP_GENERAL reports whether a name has a record of a given DNS type. TVL_LOOKUP_GENERAL returns the total value locked of a DeFi protocol or chain. WEB_SEARCH_GENERAL answers current-information queries from live web sources, citing them. CHAT_COMPLETION_GENERAL replies to general questions and conversation. RESEARCH_QUERY_GENERAL answers research questions with cited scholarly sources. SECURITY_REVIEW_GENERAL reviews code, dependencies, contracts, repositories and websites for security findings. EVENT_OUTCOME_RESOLUTION_GENERAL resolves named real-world events from settled markets and cited evidence. TOKEN_HOLDER_COUNT_GENERAL returns the number of addresses holding a token. SLA_COMPLIANCE_GENERAL returns a service's published uptime for a period and whether it met a stated target. RETURN_POLICY_VERIFY_GENERAL reads a retailer's return window and conditions from its own policy page.

miners.name: LiveCert — Sourced Answers for Agents
miners.description: Sourced answers for agents and apps across 44 intents, each read live from a named primary source so the caller can check it. Every answer opens with a one-sentence answer, then returns the values as fields, the source and the time it was checked. Compliance: sanctions screening of people, companies and wallets against the OFAC SDN and UN lists with near-match scores; company register records (status, company number, register, registered address and agent, parents) from GLEIF and SEC EDGAR; SEC filings with acceptance times and each 10-Q or 10-K's own XBRL figures; URL reputation from Cloudflare and Quad9 threat DNS, each source named. Research: question answering with every claim cited, web search with dated reports, fact checks with the source URL and evidence sentence, and academic, clinical and news search. Markets: prices and market data for coins, tokens and listed companies, 10-K revenue and earnings, exchange rates and macroeconomic prints (US CPI and unemployment from BLS, the federal funds target range from the New York Fed, euro-area HICP from Eurostat and ECB rates). On-chain: transfer verification with confirmations and the burned base fee, transaction and contract activity across EVM chains, wallet balances, gas, token holders, ERC-20 total supply and burned balance read at a pinned block from two RPCs, any named value read at a stated block height (receipt gas and Transfer amounts, storage slots, balances, block gas), and cross-chain messages. Security: live TLS certificates, URL scans, CVE records, DNS records compared across two resolvers, security reviews of packages, sites and code, and fraud signals. Weather: forecasts, current conditions and storm risk. Also translation, IP geolocation, event outcomes, text extraction, sentiment and classification. A language model (Groq gpt-oss-120b, with two fallbacks) writes chat replies, code and security reviews and requested writing, and chooses sentiment labels, fact-check ratings, news briefs and, with no market or record, recalled event outcomes; each field is checked before it is served, the request is passed as data, and a keyless answer or an honest unknown is given when no model answers. Everything else is computed, not generated.

miners.name: VeriReceipt Deterministic Oracle
miners.description: Zero-LLM deterministic provider with a SHA-256 receipt on every answer (raw_response_sha256: 64 lowercase hex characters, no 0x prefix, over the exact evidence bytes served at /receipts/{receipt_id}/raw): seven named EVM transaction chains, SEC EDGAR filing counts by company, exact form and inclusive filing-date period, DeFiLlama protocol or chain TVL, a canonical fixed-size Ethereum mainnet ETH/USDC execution quote, supported CAISO/NYISO/Elering grid prices, and finalized-root Ethereum validator effective balances. Thirty-one further receipt-backed endpoints provide academic search, Chainlink reserve attestations, GitHub CI patch verification, SEC corporate registry lookup, cross-chain transaction-state agreement, CVE records, resolved prediction-market outcomes, market data, current FX rates, IP geolocation, pool liquidity, malware and threat-intelligence blocklist reads, news headlines and search, card BIN lookup, driving ETAs, sanctions screening, delivered-uptime reads, sports scores, US equity quotes, token holder counts, transaction risk reads, US airport disruption status, URL safety reads, EU VAT verification, CVE triage and weather forecasts. Declared source, scope and freshness limits apply.
